Congenital reduction and malformation of digits and underlying bones, muscles, tendons and ligaments; skin webbing adds no independent skin dysfunction.
Congenital dyserythropoietic anemia with platelet dysfunction, neutropenia and marrow abnormalities.
Monogenic systemic autoimmunity; direct immune-mediated nephritis occurs in 11/17 patients and is an intrinsic organ manifestation.
Inherited GPVI platelet activation and aggregation defect; mucocutaneous bleeding does not establish other organ damage.

Congenital absence of the gallbladder; the gallbladder belongs to the hepatic axis.

Neurodevelopmental disorder with leukodystrophy; optic atrophy is a defining associated feature. Hypopigmentation occurs only in some individuals.

Disorder of endocrine pancreatic insulin secretion and glucose metabolism; neurologic damage is not established across this umbrella concept.
Embryonal central nervous system tumor arising in the spinal cord.
Primary carcinoma of the endometrium, a reproductive organ outside the thirteen axes.
